description: Look up an existing order placed on The Flowers Directory, using the order number from the confirmation email and the email address used at checkout. Returns the items, scheduled delivery date, delivery city and whether that date is upcoming, today or past. It does not provide live courier tracking; for delivery confirmation, changes or cancellations it returns the order-help phone and text numbers.

email.description: Email address the purchaser used at checkout.

order_number.description: Order number from the confirmation email, e.g. 123456789.

name: get_order_status
title: Look up an order
